{{Quote|Welcome to the Lucky Despot.|Baboo|<ref name="SWG:P25" />}}
'''Baboo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked at the ''[[Lucky Despot]]'', a cantina owned by the criminal leader [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:P25" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Well then I expect you can find all of those here. You should talk to either Kavas or Ind here. They work for Lady Valarian.|Baboo, to a spacer|<ref name="stf">{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; tatooine_knives_contact.stf</ref>}}
Baboo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:P25" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Baboo was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Unlike most Humans in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], Baboo had a facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]].<ref name="SWG:P25" />

Baboo was intended to be part of the cancelled [https://swglegends.com/forums/showthread.php?55817-*Friday-Feature-Valarian-Themepark-Walkthrough!*Valarian Themepark]. This questline was initially planned to be introduced in the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" to replace the original "[[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Valarian Quest Series]]."<ref name="SonyCite-Valarian Quest Update">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Current%20Publish|text=Valarian Quest Update}}</ref> Although the old "Valarian Quest Series" was deactivated with the release of Publish 23 on [[August 31]], [[2005]],<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref> the new Themepark was never activated.<ref name="SonyCite-In Development">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=In%20Development|text=In Development}}</ref> NPCs of the Valarian Theme Park such as Baboo were implemented into the game but they were not involved in any quest.<ref name="SWG:P25" />
